name: righelt
description: Righelt web app starter scaffold (Cloudflare free-tier).

scripts.dev:api: pnpm --dir apps/api exec wrangler dev --config wrangler.toml --port 8787 --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state/api-local-dev
scripts.dev:api:a: pnpm --dir apps/api exec wrangler dev --config wrangler.toml --port 8792 --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state/api-local-dev-a
scripts.dev:api:b: pnpm --dir apps/api exec wrangler dev --config wrangler.toml --port 8793 --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state/api-local-dev-b
scripts.dev:api:c: pnpm --dir apps/api exec wrangler dev --config wrangler.toml --port 8794 --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state/api-local-dev-c
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:web-engine-generated && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:integration: pnpm test:engine:integration && pnpm test:api-handler && pnpm test:api-worker && pnpm test:web:integration
scripts.db:local: pnpm --dir apps/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ${CLOUDFLARE_D1_DB_NAME:-righelt-db-dev} --config wrangler.toml --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state/api-local-dev
scripts.db:local:a: pnpm --dir apps/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ${CLOUDFLARE_D1_DB_NAME:-righelt-db-dev} --config wrangler.toml --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state/api-local-dev-a
scripts.db:local:b: pnpm --dir apps/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ${CLOUDFLARE_D1_DB_NAME:-righelt-db-dev} --config wrangler.toml --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state/api-local-dev-b
scripts.db:local:c: pnpm --dir apps/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ${CLOUDFLARE_D1_DB_NAME:-righelt-db-dev} --config wrangler.toml --local --persist-to ../../.wrangler/state/api-local-dev-c
scripts.deploy:api: pnpm --dir apps/api exec wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler pages deploy . --project-name ${CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_PROJECT:-righelt}
